registration: the public executable-example home is registered by contracts/web-product-expansion-v1.md §7 and built by the docs reference harness (docs/scripts/reference-harness.mjs, invoked from pnpm docs:build)

currentEstates.rule: sandbox application exercised by compiler and conformance work; not a published user example
fixture components for compiler tests; not a published user example

requirements: an example is publishable only when it passes the docs reference harness static-proof check (published package.json exports, shipped bins, links, capability catalog ids) with pinned engine and package versions
example output is reproducible from the product receipt basis of contracts/product-experience.md §4
screenshots and roadmap claims never stand in for working examples

only examples/reference entries that pass the docs reference harness may be presented as static-proof public examples; they are not executed evidence. Contributor sandboxes remain unpublished. Runtime execution of examples is deferred to DOC5 executable journeys

SDK and official-extension guide topics declared in examples/reference/manifest.json sdkGuides carry pending or supplied slots; a supplied slot must bind a manifest example with an executable source file plus a shipped-bin command or public import, and the SDK documentation gate (docs reference harness --sdk-gate) fails any static sample, unbound slot or pending topic
doc1Acceptance: the harness statically validates every published example in the release lane (exports, bins, links, capability ids); it does not execute examples. Example execution is deferred to DOC5
reference pages generated by DOC3 are validated against their sources by the same harness
a broken or drifted example fails the release-selected documentation checks before promotion
